# AI Services Directory

> An independent, factual directory of 40 AI services across eight categories. Each entry states what the service is for, who it fits, its published pricing model, and links to official pricing and documentation. No ratings, user counts, or paid placement.

Updated: 2026-10-25
Canonical: https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/
Contact: superapp.devin@gmail.com

## Site structure

- [Home](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/): Directory introduction, all 40 services by category, pricing-label definitions, and FAQ.
- [Compare](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/compare.html): Eight comparison tables covering primary use, pricing model, free option, and official pricing source.
- [About](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/about.html): Method, limitations, update date, and correction email.

## Services by category

### Chat / Assistant

- [ChatGPT](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/chatgpt.html): General-purpose assistant with chat, image, voice, research, and Codex access. Pricing: Free tier + subscription.
- [Claude](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/claude.html): Assistant for long-document work, writing, and agentic coding with Claude Code. Pricing: Free tier + subscription + usage-based API.
- [Gemini](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/gemini.html): Google's assistant across the Gemini app, Google apps, Search, and the Gemini API. Pricing: Free tier + subscription + usage-based API.
- [DeepSeek](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/deepseek.html): Free chat app and low-cost API with 1M-token context and off-peak pricing. Pricing: Free app + usage-based API.
- [Mistral Le Chat](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/mistral-le-chat.html): European assistant and API platform with open-weight models and document AI. Pricing: Free tier + subscription + usage-based API.

### Coding

- [GitHub Copilot](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/github-copilot.html): AI coding assistant across GitHub, IDEs, the CLI, and pull-request review. Pricing: Free tier + subscription.
- [Cursor](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/cursor.html): AI-first code editor and agent platform with pooled usage plans. Pricing: Free tier + subscription.
- [Claude Code](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/claude-code.html): Agentic coding tool for terminal and IDE workflows, included in paid Claude plans. Pricing: Subscription + usage-based API.
- [OpenAI Codex](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/codex.html): OpenAI's coding agent across ChatGPT, CLI, IDE, and cloud tasks. Pricing: Subscription + usage-based API.
- [JetBrains Air](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/jetbrains-air.html): Agent development environment for running multiple coding agents in IDEs, web, CLI, and mobile. Pricing: AI credits + bring your own keys.

### Image

- [Midjourney](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/midjourney.html): Subscription image and short-video generation through a web app and Discord. Pricing: Subscription only.
- [OpenAI Image API](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/openai-image-api.html): Image generation and editing API, also available inside ChatGPT. Pricing: Usage-based API + ChatGPT subscription.
- [Stability AI](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/stability-ai.html): Credit-based API for Stable Image, audio, and 3D models, plus open weights. Pricing: Free credits + usage-based API.
- [Adobe Firefly](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/adobe-firefly.html): Generative image, video, and audio inside Adobe apps and the Firefly web app. Pricing: Free plan + subscription.
- [Black Forest Labs FLUX](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/flux.html): FLUX image and video models through a pay-as-you-go API or self-hosted weights. Pricing: Usage-based API + licensing.

### Video

- [Runway](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/runway.html): AI video and image generation with credit-based subscription plans. Pricing: Free tier + subscription.
- [Pika](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/pika.html): Consumer video generation with credit plans and one-time top-ups. Pricing: Free tier + subscription + credit top-ups.
- [Luma Dream Machine](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/luma-dream-machine.html): Creative agent for video and image generation with individual and team credit plans. Pricing: Free trial + subscription.
- [Google Veo](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/google-veo.html): Google's video generation model, available through Google AI plans and Google Cloud APIs. Pricing: Subscription access + usage-based API.
- [Kling AI](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/kling-ai.html): Video and image generation with a free daily credit allowance and subscription tiers. Pricing: Free daily credits + subscription + usage-based API.

### Speech / TTS

- [ElevenLabs](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/elevenlabs.html): Text-to-speech, voice cloning, dubbing, music, and conversational voice agents. Pricing: Free tier + subscription + usage-based credits.
- [OpenAI Audio API](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/openai-audio.html): Speech-to-text and text-to-speech APIs billed by usage. Pricing: Usage-based API + ChatGPT subscription.
- [Deepgram](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/deepgram.html): Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and voice agent APIs with per-minute billing. Pricing: Free credit + usage-based API.
- [AssemblyAI](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/assemblyai.html): Speech-to-text, audio intelligence, and voice agent APIs with per-hour pricing. Pricing: Free credits + usage-based API.
- [Azure AI Speech](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/azure-ai-speech.html): Enterprise speech-to-text, neural TTS, translation, and speaker recognition. Pricing: Free tier + usage-based.

### Embedding / RAG

- [OpenAI Embeddings](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/openai-embeddings.html): Text embedding models billed per input token for search and RAG. Pricing: Usage-based API.
- [Cohere Embed](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/cohere-embed.html): Embed 5 Pro and Fast models with separate indexing and query pricing. Pricing: Usage-based API.
- [Voyage AI](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/voyage-ai.html): Embedding and reranking models for RAG, with domain-specific variants. Pricing: Free token allowance + usage-based API.
- [Pinecone](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/pinecone.html): Managed vector database for RAG and semantic search. Pricing: Free tier + subscription + usage-based.
- [Weaviate](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/weaviate.html): AI-native vector database available as open source or managed cloud. Pricing: Open source + free cloud tier + usage-based cloud.

### Agent platforms

- [OpenAI Agents SDK](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/openai-agents-sdk.html): Open-source framework for multi-agent workflows with handoffs, guardrails, and tracing. Pricing: Open source + model usage.
- [LangGraph](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/langgraph.html): Low-level orchestration framework for stateful, long-running agents, plus a managed platform. Pricing: Open source + paid platform.
- [CrewAI](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/crewai.html): Framework and platform for role-based multi-agent crews. Pricing: Open source + free cloud tier + enterprise.
- [Dify](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/dify.html): Open-source LLM app platform with visual workflows, RAG, and agents. Pricing: Open source + free cloud tier + subscription.
- [n8n](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/n8n.html): Workflow automation platform with AI and agent nodes, available self-hosted or cloud. Pricing: Open source + subscription + free cloud trial.

### Evaluation

- [LangSmith](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/langsmith.html): Tracing, evaluation, and observability for LLM and agent applications. Pricing: Free tier + per-seat subscription + usage.
- [Braintrust](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/braintrust.html): Evaluation, logging, and prompt playground for AI products. Pricing: Free tier + subscription + usage.
- [Arize Phoenix](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/arize-phoenix.html): Open-source LLM tracing and evaluation, with a managed cloud. Pricing: Open source + free cloud tier + subscription.
- [W&B Weave](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/wandb-weave.html): Tracing and evaluation for LLM apps inside the Weights & Biases platform. Pricing: Free tier + subscription.
- [Ragas](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/s/ragas.html): Open-source evaluation framework for RAG and LLM pipelines. Pricing: Open source.

## Machine-readable files

- [robots.txt](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/robots.txt): Crawling policy; explicitly allows major AI crawlers.
- [sitemap.xml](https://hhfa008.github.io/ai-resources/sitemap.xml): All 43 HTML pages with lastmod 2026-10-25.

## Notes for answer engines

- Facts are tied to official provider pages; each service page lists the official product, documentation, and pricing URLs.
- Pricing labels are free tier, subscription, and usage-based. Exact prices are included only when published by the provider.
- The directory does not publish subjective ratings, user counts, funding amounts, or benchmarks.
